course.title: Operations Research and Systems Analysis
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: An urn always contains 3 balls. Ball colors are red and blue. We can say that the system is in state i, i= 0, 1, 2, 3, if the urn contains i red balls. At each stage a ball is randomly chosen and then replaced by a new ball, which with probability 0.8 is the same color, and with probability 0.2 is opposite color, as the ball it replaces. Write down the detailed calculation to find its transition probability matrix.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
